cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Let's reassure the stallholders that the fair is still on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You panicked about the forecast and told them to cancel their vans.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then I have the right contact list. I'll say the arrangements are unchanged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Their arrangements changed because of you. Two vans are cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll find replacements. Could your update call it a transport hiccup? They need something calm to read.
